observation: contextBundle decoded allowed text-extension files with Buffer utf8 conversion, which silently replaced malformed byte sequences with U+FFFD and presented synthesized text to cognition as repository reality.
pre_fix_reproduction: A broken.js file containing invalid UTF-8 bytes was admitted into context with replacement characters instead of being rejected.
change: Decode candidate context bytes with a fatal UTF-8 TextDecoder and skip malformed text inside the existing fail-closed contextBundle path.
truth_boundary: This proves UTF-8 decoding integrity only. It does not detect semantically binary data that happens to be valid UTF-8 or validate source-language syntax.
